description: Grid Supply Point Project Status Breakdown is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction Following the submission of evidence to NESO on the 10th of September 2025 of eligible Gate 2 to Whole Queue projects (G2tWQ), UK Power Networks seeks to provide further insight, at the Grid Supply Point (GSP) level, on the progress status of generation projects. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network Usage. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
